title: DiffResult
description: The primary deliverable of the matchy tool: a deterministic, machine-actionable diff between two rendered pages.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Version of the DiffResult schema. Always '1.0' in v1.

toolVersion.title: Tool version
toolVersion.description: Version of the matchy binary that produced this result (from CARGO_PKG_VERSION).

runId.title: Run identifier
runId.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run start. Excluded from golden comparisons.

oldUrl.title: Old URL
oldUrl.description: The URL of the old (baseline) page.

newUrl.title: New URL
newUrl.description: The URL of the new (candidate) page.

parityProfile.title: Parity profile
parityProfile.description: The parity profile used to map issue categories to severities.

status.title: Overall status
status.description: Aggregate pass/warn/fail/error status for the entire run.

agentSummary.title: Agent summary
agentSummary.description: Machine-first triage block. First in file for fast agent consumption.

fixableNow.title: Fixable now count
fixableNow.description: Count of issues with severity >= warning AND anchor strength >= medium AND non-null remediation.

byType.title: Issues by type
byType.description: Count of issues per issue type, sorted by type key (BTreeMap order).

clusterCount.title: Cluster count
clusterCount.description: Number of issue clusters in this result.

topFixes.title: Top fixes
topFixes.description: First N (default 5) issue or cluster IDs ordered by descending fix value.

scores.title: Scores
scores.description: Per-category parity scores in [0, 1]. 1.0 = identical, 0.0 = completely different.

visual.title: Visual score
visual.description: 1 - pageChangedRatio over common height, clamped to [0, 1].

viewports.title: Per-viewport results
viewports.description: One entry per configured viewport, in configuration order.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: All emitted issues, sorted by descending fix value (severityWeight * confidence * localityBonus), tie-broken ascending by id.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.description: Deterministic issue clusters. Empty in M1.

determinism.title: Determinism report
determinism.description: Worst-across-viewports determinism step status for old and new pages.

artifacts.title: Top-level artifacts
artifacts.description: Paths to the primary viewport's screenshots and diff image (relative to the output directory).

IssueType.title: Issue type
IssueType.description: Stable string taxonomy for all issue types (spec §7.3).

Anchors.title: Anchor set
Anchors.description: Semantic fingerprint of the element — the agent-facing locator. All string fields are nullable.

text.title: Visible text
text.description: Normalized visible text of the element. Strongest grep target when present.

role.title: ARIA role
role.description: ARIA role or implicit HTML role.

href.title: Resolved href
href.description: Absolute resolved href for links and CTAs.

nearestHeading.title: Nearest heading
nearestHeading.description: Text of the most recent heading node in document order before this element.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: Nearest ancestor landmark role (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo, complementary, form).

ordinalInLandmark.title: Ordinal in landmark
ordinalInLandmark.description: 1-based count of prior nodes with the same (kind, text) in the same landmark, including self.

Locator.title: Issue locator
Locator.description: Locates the element involved in the issue. anchors are agent-facing; other fields are tool-internal.

cssSelectorOld.title: CSS selector (old page)
cssSelectorOld.description: Internal tool-use only: landmark-relative CSS selector on the old page.

cssSelectorNew.title: CSS selector (new page)
cssSelectorNew.description: Internal tool-use only: landmark-relative CSS selector on the new page.

bboxOld.title: Bounding box (old page)
bboxOld.description: Bounding box [x, y, w, h] in CSS pixels on the old page.

bboxNew.title: Bounding box (new page)
bboxNew.description: Bounding box [x, y, w, h] in CSS pixels on the new page.

seqIndexOld.title: Sequence index (old page)
seqIndexOld.description: Document-order index of the matched node on the old page.

seqIndexNew.title: Sequence index (new page)
seqIndexNew.description: Document-order index of the matched node on the new page.

Remediation.title: Remediation
Remediation.description: Structured fix description. Deterministic, no AI inference.

action.title: Action
action.description: The type of fix to apply.

id.title: Issue ID
id.description: Content-addressed stable ID: 'issue_' + first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over canonical fields.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence score in [0, 1], rounded to 4 decimal places.

viewport.title: Viewport name
viewport.description: Name of the viewport this issue was detected in.

goal.title: User goal
goal.description: Which user goal (G1-G8) this issue serves, when applicable.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Type-specific evidence payload. Shape varies by issue type.

remediation.title: Remediation
remediation.description: Structured fix description, or null when no deterministic fix is known.

Cluster.title: Cluster
Cluster.description: A group of related issues sharing a common root cause.

issueIds.title: Issue IDs
issueIds.description: IDs of issues in this cluster.

sharedProperty.title: Shared property
sharedProperty.description: CSS property shared by all issues in this cluster (for style clusters).

sharedLandmark.title: Shared landmark
sharedLandmark.description: Landmark shared by all issues in this cluster (for landmark clusters).

animationsDisabled.title: Animations disabled
animationsDisabled.description: Status of the animations-disabled stabilization step.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Status of the reduced-motion emulation step.

timeFrozen.title: Time frozen
timeFrozen.description: Status of the time-freeze stabilization step.

randomStubbed.title: Random stubbed
randomStubbed.description: Status of the Math.random stubbing step.

fontsReady.title: Fonts ready
fontsReady.description: Status of the document.fonts.ready wait step.

imagesDecoded.title: Images decoded
imagesDecoded.description: Status of the image decode wait step.

lazyLoadPass.title: Lazy load pass
lazyLoadPass.description: Status of the lazy-load scroll pass.

settled.title: Settled
settled.description: Status of the final settle wait.

clicked.title: Clicked selectors
clicked.description: Selectors that were clicked before capture.

hidden.title: Hidden selectors
hidden.description: Selectors that were hidden before capture.

masked.title: Masked selectors
masked.description: Selectors that were masked before capture.

retriedWithoutTimeFreeze.title: Retried without time freeze
retriedWithoutTimeFreeze.description: True if the capture was retried after networkidle timeout with time freeze disabled.

issues.title: Issue IDs
issues.description: IDs of issues detected in this viewport.

Artifacts.title: Artifacts
Artifacts.description: Paths to screenshot and diff PNG artifacts (relative to output directory).

old.title: Old screenshot path
old.description: Path to the old page full-page screenshot.

new.title: New screenshot path
new.description: Path to the new page full-page screenshot.

diff.title: Diff image path
diff.description: Path to the visual diff PNG.
